title: Dependency-aware retirement of obsolete witnessed derived populations
question: Can obsolete structural/contextual/reference rows be removed completely while preserving authenticated source custody and current replacement journeys?
method: Reviewed repeatable-read catalog-FK closure restricted to corpus_structure_dev, with protected source refusal, foreign keys enforced, original user-trigger modes restored and source counts checked in the committing transaction; separate current-protocol/result verification.
conclusion: Removed26 obsolete runs/81 tasks/52 results and dependent obsolete contextual, reference and publication rows across20 tables. Protected source counts52builds/62views/380artifacts were unchanged. Only current structural/frame protocols remain; current completed120/121/127/130 survive. This establishes bounded data retirement, not full WCE qualification or deletion of authenticated source evidence.
